audit_scope: Incremental-to-complete PhyloTree Build 17 audit for issue 1798. 165 marker-exact nodes retain emitted-marker and coverage locks; independent raw-row comparison classifies 160 direct motifs as exact and 5 legacy motifs as partial. All other emitted nodes have explicit pending or structural states. Schema v3 distinguishes general flattened source intermediates from caller-unreportable intermediates and separately accounts for retired emitted identities. Completion requires every direct motif and source-topology edge to become exact.
